type_en: fitted case with a collection of amber brooches
visual_en: Mahogany-coloured wooden case with a small plaque on the lid and a gilt latch set with an amber cabochon; inside, a navy velvet tray of 12 compartments holds vintage amber brooches (floral, leaf and grape designs), earrings, polished nuggets and a faceted drop pendant. #358 is a close-up of a leaf brooch with a faceted cognac bead.
notes_en: #355 closed lid (the latch cabochon peeks out under the lid edge), #356 latch, #357 open case, #358 detail. Treated as one set (case with fitted contents) because it is photographed as a unit; the ~15 items inside could be split into separate pieces if they are sold individually. Some faceted cherry/cognac elements may be pressed amber or glass rather than natural amber.
